items.q: Do I need my phone nearby?
items.a: No. Recording happens on the device and syncs later. The Tikpal App is where you review and manage your tasks.

items.q: What if Tikpal gets a detail wrong?
items.a: Every task is editable in the Tikpal App, so you can fix anything before it matters.
Most orders arrive within 5–10 business days in the US and Asia-Pacific, and 7–12 business days in Europe. Exact estimates are shown at checkout.
